data.name: The Last Feather
data.detailed_description:
The Last Feather is a fast-paced top-down shooter that follows a rooster on a brutal path of vengeance after his family is murdered by a ruthless gang. With every step through ruined buildings and flickering neon streets, danger is everywhere—and nothing will stop him.

As players chase the gang across countries and cities, they will face reflex-based combat, intense close-quarters fights, explosive encounters, and challenging boss battles. Each level introduces new objectives: area clearance, rescue missions, time-based challenges, stealth segments, and tough mini-bosses.

The game features:

High-speed, punishing top-down action,

A wide selection of firearms and melee weapons,

Collectible feather shards for character upgrades,

Varied environments from neon-lit cities to devastated towns,

Unique enemy types and attack patterns,

A single-player story mode with strong replay value.

Every bullet, explosion, and fight pumps adrenaline straight into your veins. This is not just a tale of revenge—it’s a chaotic, relentless action experience that pulls players into its savage world.

data.short_description: The Last Feather is a high-octane top-down shooter packed with raw brutality, hard-edged gunfights, and bone-crushing close combat. Through neon-soaked streets and relentless encounters, it delivers a fierce journey of vengeance with every step.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10, 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i3-2125, AMD Phenom II X4 960 or equivalent
  • Graphics: 512 MB VRAM, Radeon Vega 7/GTX 1030/Intel Iris 550 or equivalent
  • Storage: 10 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 10, 64-bit
  • Processor: Ryzen 3 3300X or equivalent
  • Graphics: 512 MB VRAM, RX 460/GTX 1050/Iris Xe DG1 or equivalent
  • Storage: 10 GB available space

content_descriptors.notes: This game contains intense violence; characters may be shot with firearms, blood is visible, and injuries or dismemberment can occur. Some dialogues or symbols may reference alcohol or drug use, but the game does not depict direct use or encourage it. The game does not include sexual content or self-harm. Violence and disturbing scenes may not be suitable for all players.
